name: Pyra
alt: Pyra the Emberward, wreathed in fire
tagline: Settles disputes quickly and warmly. Afterward there is no dispute, and usually no building.
style: She has one answer, and it is fire. She aims it at the enemy hero from the first turn and will burn herself to keep the heat coming.
points: Spells that deal damage to minions or the enemy hero.
Cards that trade Health for power.
Minions that attack the turn you play them.

name: Fenwick
alt: Fenwick the Clockwright, an inventor holding a crackling brass sphere
tagline: Created a big problem by building a machine that solves every problem.
style: He builds machines out of small parts. He spends most of his time in his workshop or his library. His constructs overwhelm opponents while his hero power keeps his options open.
points: Buffs that reach every friendly Construct at once turn a wide board into a tall one.
Blueprint draws a card every turn, and a few spells pick a minion back up so it can be played again.

name: Sorrow
alt: Sorrow the Gravekeep, a hooded skeletal figure with a lantern
tagline: Keeps the cemetery, and is concerned by how many residents keep leaving it.
style: He treats a death as the start of a career. What he buries pays him on the way down, and some of it gets back up.
points: Minions that pay out when they die.
Cards that sacrifice one of your own minions for a reward.
Spells that return dead minions to the board.

name: Liss
alt: Liss the Nightveil, a masked assassin on a moonlit rooftop
tagline: Nobody saw Liss arrive. Three complaints about it have been filed anyway.
style: She picks her fights and is gone before the next one. What she cannot kill, she sends home.
points: Minions that cannot be attacked or targeted until they strike.
Minions that destroy whatever they damage.
Spells that destroy a minion or return it to its owner's hand.

name: Hodge
alt: Hodge the Stonewarden, an armored giant with a tower shield
tagline: Built a wall, then built a second wall to protect the first one.
style: He stands behind his wall for as long as it takes. When it is finished, he walks through whatever is left.
points: Minions that must be attacked first.
Buffs that add Health.
Large minions whose extra damage carries through to the enemy hero.

name: Cassian
alt: Cassian the Tempest, a storm mage hurling lightning
tagline: Treats the weather as a suggestion. The suggestion is usually lightning.
style: He is the fastest thing in the kingdom and the least sure where he is aiming. The lightning picks its own targets, and he borrows from tomorrow to pay for it.
points: Minions that attack twice each turn.
Damage that lands on random enemies.
Strong cards that lock some of your mana next turn.

name: Maren
alt: Maren the Tidecaller, a sea mystic holding a driftwood staff
tagline: Summons the tide twice a day, which the tide was already doing without help.
style: She is in no hurry. She freezes whatever comes at her, drowns the largest of it down to size, and wins with what is still standing.
points: Cards that freeze attackers where they stand.
Damage that grows with the target's Health.
Spells that return minions to their owner's hand.

name: Thalen
alt: Thalen the Verdant, an ancient tree spirit cradling a sapling
tagline: Heals the land, and has since sent the land an invoice.
style: He plays the long game. He heals through the early turns, grows his mana ahead of schedule, and then sets down something too large to argue with.
points: Healing from spells and minions.
Cards that add Mana Crystals early.
Large minions whose extra damage carries through to the enemy hero.
